notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/da0a4bc8e226908bc318aae5ae5b54377f95500c.png[/img]
[h3]Hi Everyone,[/h3]

In Version 1.5, the outlook of Poisohell has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/b8257320f2256ce2d5662e365c45b8c404bd1b69.jpg[/img]
Also, there are some modifications come with this version. Please feel free to check it out!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Poisohell Outlook
[*] Add Vases to Poisohell
[/list]
[h2]Modification[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhance performance
[*] Modify some language translation
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi Everyone,[/h3]

I want to apologize for the bugs that have affected your experience while playing the game.

This update has fixed some of the issues. There are some known issues still remain and I will work on it in the coming days. Thank you for your understanding and support.

[h2]Bugs Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix Upgrade action not stopping after switch to other upgrades
[*] Fix game stuck after pressing controller button at Loading Page
[*] Fix Ability Calculation Display Page not appear when game is pausing
[*] Fix wrong skill icon display of some characters
[/list]
